question: At the exact functionmix midpoint and deployed per-family update radius, does increasing only task-matched residual chart capacity recover a material, held-out fraction of the same-radius dense c_fc/c_proj direction gain?
authorization: One zero-persistent-update capacity bracket only. No training run, raw step-radius increase, learned basis, LoRA, HyperConnection, residual-topology change, larger rung, MFU preflight, watchdog, callback, queue worker, or heartbeat is authorized.

protocol.same_replay_state: Construct every candidate from one gradient, clipped state, persisted momentum, functional activation context, and base model. Take the actual production c_fc/c_proj optimizer steps only after candidate construction so the exact control is not confounded by cross-run CUDA nondeterminism.
protocol.c_fc_expansion: Keep the 64-stage parent, functionmix beta 0.5, recursive condition limit 1.01, selection seed, neighbors, and activation context fixed; change only shear residual stages from 24 to 40 or 64.
protocol.c_proj_expansion: Keep the 64-stage parent, fresh task matching, selection seed, neighbors, and exact dense-Muon request fixed; change only residual stages from 24 to 40 or 64.
protocol.fixed_radius: After constructing an expanded direction, globally normalize that family to the actual deployed BF16 endpoint Frobenius norm, iterating through BF16 endpoint quantization. Reject any candidate exceeding the registered radius error.
protocol.exact_restore: Restore every BF16 materialized MLP tensor around every candidate. Persist zero model or optimizer updates to the checkpoint.

decision_rule.reliable_improvement: Candidate-minus-production 99% CI upper bound below zero and negative mean on every held-out window.
decision_rule.family_pass: For a family and capacity level, both its singleton and hybrid substitution must be reliable improvements; the worse comparison must recover at least 25% and their mean at least 40% of the equal-radius dense-oracle gap measured on the same windows.
decision_rule.joint_pass: The same-level joint candidate must reliably improve production joint and recover at least 40% of the equal-radius dense-joint gap on the same windows.
decision_rule.selection: Select the smaller registered residual-stage level only if c_fc, c_proj, and joint all pass. Otherwise do not select a training candidate.
decision_rule.architecture_gate: A passing result authorizes only implementation and performance preflight of the smallest passing same-topology capacity. It does not directly authorize training, learned bases, LoRA, HyperConnection, residual changes, or larger rungs.

execution.monitoring: direct foreground polling only; no watchdog, callback, queue worker, or heartbeat
